variant_decisions.evidence: Qere וְקָדְשֵׁי is a construct plural (C/Ncmpc) with no suffix, which makes the following בֵּית יְהוָה its nomen rectum: "and the holy things of the house of Jehovah." Ketiv וקדשו is singular with a 3ms suffix (C/Ncmsc/Sp3ms), "and his holy things," leaving בֵּית יְהוָה free to complete the verb. The ASV takes the second path on both counts: it reads "he brought into the house of Jehovah ... and the things that himself had dedicated," attaching the house to וַיָּבֵא and supplying a reflexive possessor the qere has no morpheme for. The suffix is visible in the English, so the ketiv is selected.
